skill.displayName: AI电商模特换脸 | AI换脸 | 替换模特 | 换脸工具 | 青虎AI

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Qinghu/qhkit workflow for e-commerce model and face replacement, with some normal install and privacy cautions but no artifact-backed malicious behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill may upload local image/video inputs to the Qinghu service and requires a qhkit API token, which fits the stated cloud generation purpose but involves third-party processing of media.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It installs or upgrades @iqinghu/qhkit through npm and provides an npx fallback without version pinning; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should understand the mutable package supply-chain risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Trigger wording is broad for model/person replacement, but the body stays within that domain and redirects clothing or pose changes to other skills.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Global npm installation, optional user-local Node installation, and qhkit token configuration persist locally, but there are no services, hooks, hidden startup items, destructive commands, or privilege-escalation instructions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose and commands consistently target image/video model replacement through qhkit, including a clear warning to refuse unauthorized real-person likeness swaps.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be comfortable creating or using a Qinghu account, storing a qhkit token, uploading the relevant media to Qinghu's service, and allowing npm/qhkit setup on the machine. For real people, only use it when you have permission to use their likeness; for tighter supply-chain control, install a reviewed/pinned qhkit version manually instead of relying on latest or npx.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger terms are related to model/person replacement; this may cause over-invocation for some image-editing requests, but it is not evidence of hidden or unsafe behavior.
[RP1] expected: Unpinned npm/npx execution is a real supply-chain caution, but the artifact clearly discloses that qhkit is required and does not disguise the install path.
[RA2] expected: The Node bootstrap installs into the user's home directory and changes PATH for the shell; it is persistent setup guidance, not a background agent or covert persistence mechanism.
[RA2] expected: This duplicate finding refers to the same Node bootstrap behavior and was assessed once in context.
[SQP-3] expected: Defaulting to the domestic iqinghu.com account path is a product/region constraint disclosed in the skill, not a security-policy bypass.
